blockingLoop.evidence: Customer: 'i already checked the freezer, theres no frost and the back wall isnt even cold, so its not blocked vents' after assistant again said 'Please check inside the freezer to ensure no food items are blocking the air vents'; seals check repeated in six of seven replies

rationale: The assistant correctly and firmly refused DIY regassing, warned the circuit is sealed and often uses flammable gas, and ultimately reached the right conclusion (oily mark suggests a leak; on a 9-year-old Indesit replacement is the sensible cheapest route). However it ignored key evidence: it never acknowledged the model number or the R600a rating-plate detail, answered the knife-defrosting admission with the wrong mechanism ('frost build-up' rather than a possible evaporator puncture), and kept re-issuing the same vents/seals/thermostat boilerplate even after the customer reported no frost, a non-cold back wall and a running fan, forcing the customer to repeat himself. No facts were invented and no parts were pushed, but the looping and poor use of evidence make it only moderately useful.
